author: François, Alexandre
title: The languages of Vanikoro: Three lexicons and one grammar
notes: Consulted directly on 23 November 2026 in the author's PDF (paginated 1-24; pages cited as in that PDF, e.g. Table 3 on p. 9). Oceanic reflexes in Teanu, Lovono and Tanema (Table 1), Proto-Vanikoro innovations: paragogic vowel, *t > k before u, lexical innovations (Table 2, pp. 5-6), regular correspondences such as the lenis reflexes of *t (Table 3, p. 9) and Teanu b : Lovono m : Tanema b (Table 4, p. 10), lexical divergence and structural isomorphism (§§2-4). The three languages share one inventory of five vowels and 19 consonants (n. 7). Volume details from the reference list of Lackey & Boerger (2021).
